techchange-one-acre-fund:greenhouse:7822.title: MEL Data Automation officer
techchange-one-acre-fund:greenhouse:7822.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips more than 4 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across ten countries that together are home to more than two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase her income and assets on supported land by more than 40 percent, while permanently improving her climate resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 8,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. 

To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About our Internship Program

Join the One Acre Fund 2026 Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) Internship Program to jump-start your career. We empower you as you grow in this program which is especially designed for motivated young professionals.

When joining, you will participate in an onboarding program and receive training on how to accomplish your assigned projects. Over the period of your internship, you will also receive opportunities to learn directly from inspiring leaders to build foundations for your future career.

About the Role

We are seeking One MEL Data Automation officer for 6 month internships to support our Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) team. As an intern, you will contribute to impactful projects aimed at enhancing One Acre Fund’s ability to serve farmers and improve agricultural productivity and incomes. You will gain exposure to real-world data challenges and opportunities to generate actionable insights. You will work as a part of our dynamic MEL team and will directly report to the MEL Leads.

This is a JL3 internship position with a 6-month fixed-term contract. No extension will be offered.

Your responsibilities may include one or more of the following

  • Clean and analyze primary data collected from the farmers and markets.
  • Visualize results and compile them into actionable reports and automated dashboards. 

You have

  • Education in Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Experience cleaning and analyzing large datasets.
  • Proficiency in R or Stata.
  • Skills in data visualization and report writing.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Prior experience is an advantage, ideally at least one year in a relevant role.

Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

  • Addis Ababa or Bahir Dar, Ethiopia

Contract Duration

6 months

Eligibility

These internships are only open to citizens or permanent residents of Uganda or Ethiopia. 

Application Deadline

July 15, 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed until a hire is made.

To apply, please submit your CV and respond to the application questions. 

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization's mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected, so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

usv-carbonchain:greenhouse:5786289004.title: Senior Backend Engineer
usv-carbonchain:greenhouse:5786289004.description:
About CarbonChain

Want to work on the most pressing challenge of our generation? If you have experience building exceptional products, know how to execute at scale, and want to help build a company for the long term, we'd love to hear from you.

CarbonChain helps the world’s biggest supply chains measure and reduce their carbon emissions, using verified primary data where possible, and robust defaults where it isn’t. We build software that turns messy, real-world operational and supplier information into decision-grade carbon and compliance insights, so teams can act: improve sourcing, meet regulations like CBAM, and deliver credible reporting to customers, investors, and regulators.

We’re a product-led company operating in a high-stakes domain. Data quality, auditability, reliability, and trust matter as much as speed. If you enjoy building systems that customers rely on, and shipping improvements that measurably change behaviour across a network, you’ll feel at home here.

Our Product

Our platform combines real-world emissions data with our customers' supply chain information to create actionable insights. We help sustainability teams answer critical questions: Where are the emissions hotspots in our supply chain? Which suppliers should we prioritize? What's the carbon impact of switching vendors or routes?

A major focus of what we’re building right now is supplier engagement and CBAM data management:

  • enabling installations (goods producers) to prepare, manage, and share CBAM datasets through guided product carbon accounting workflows;
  • improving our supplier database and connection management to support sharing across supply chains;
  • and building ingestion pipelines that turn messy customer files into structured, provenance-tracked, insights-ready data.

Beyond CBAM, our platform supports product and corporate carbon footprinting used by some of the world’s largest commodities producers and traders, helping teams move from data collection to credible reporting and decision-making

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build robust, scalable systems that power our product. This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you'll own meaningful projects and directly influence how our engineering team works.

You'll focus on shipping well-crafted backend systems while collaborating closely with the team to deliver features that solve real customer problems. We value engineers who take initiative, care about the details, and aren't afraid to venture beyond their primary domain when needed.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build backend systems that handle complex carbon data workflows and integrations
  • Own features from technical design through deployment - you'll drive your projects forward with autonomy
  • Write clean, maintainable code and establish patterns that other engineers can follow
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and designers to translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape our technical standards
  • Occasionally jump into frontend work when needed - we value versatility and believe the best solutions come from understanding the full picture
  • Participate in code reviews and help maintain high engineering standards across the team

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building complex software systems across the full development lifecycle
  • Strong backend engineering skills with experience building modern web applications
  • Deep knowledge of Python and familiarity with frontend technologies like TypeScript
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases, job queues, and asynchronous processing
  • Knowledge of IaC/Terraform and modern CI/CD practices
  • Strong collaboration skills—you work closely with Product to ideate features, advise on trade-offs, and iterate on what we've built
  • A product-minded approach: you understand why you're building something, not just how
  • Bonus: startup or SaaS experience
  • Bonus: experience with data-intensive systems or climate/sustainability tech

 

What We Offer

Meaningful impact and accelerated growth

This is a rare opportunity to work on technology that directly addresses the climate crisis while shaping the future of a fast-growing company. You'll have significant influence over our technical direction and product strategy - the kind of impact that typically takes decades to achieve elsewhere.

You'll tackle diverse challenges, work across the full stack of problems (technical and otherwise), and own meaningful projects from start to finish. If you want to learn quickly, take on real responsibility, and see the direct results of your work, this is the place to do it.

Competitive salary and benefits:

  • 28 days annual leave
  • £500 home office setup allowance
  • £2,000 annual learning allowance
  • Private healthcare
  • Generous parental leave policy
  • Weekly team lunches in the office
  • Office gym, and cycle to work scheme

CarbonChain values diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. 

If you think your skills and experience match what we’re looking for and you’d like to join the next Climate Tech industry unicorn, please get in touch!

You can find out more about interviewing at CarbonChain at https://www.carbonchain.com/careers/interview-process.

verdane-caia-cosmetics:teamtailor:e965ce.title: Beauty Consultant, Frankfurt
verdane-caia-cosmetics:teamtailor:e965ce.description:
CAIA Cosmetics wurde 2018 in Stockholm gegründet – mit der klaren Vision, kompromisslos hochwertige Beauty-Produkte zu erschwinglichen Preisen zu entwickeln. 
Seitdem steht CAIA für leistungsstarke, sorgfältig entwickelte Produkte, die Qualität, Funktionalität und Ästhetik vereinen. Inspiriert von unserer skandinavischen Herkunft verbinden wir Leichtigkeit, Wärme und klares Design mit durchdachter Produktentwicklung. 
Wir glauben, dass Schönheit ein Gefühl ist – strahlend, mühelos und ganz individuell. Qualität, Zugänglichkeit und eine starke Community bilden das Fundament unserer Marke und prägen alles, was wir tun. 
DEINE ROLLE 
Für unseren Counter in Frankfurt suchen wir dich als Beauty Consultant (m/w/d) in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit. 
Du bist unser CAIA Brand Ambassador auf der Fläche und begeisterst unsere Kund:innen mit authentischer Beratung und deiner Leidenschaft für Beauty. Mit deinem Gespür für Trends, Produkte und individuelle Bedürfnisse schaffst du ein besonderes Einkaufserlebnis und baust persönliche Kundenbeziehungen auf. 
DEINE AUFGABEN 
Verkauf & Kundenberatung 
Du berätst unsere Kund:innen individuell, typgerecht und bedürfnisorientiert 
Du inspirierst mit deinem Produktwissen und schaffst ein positives, einladendes Einkaufserlebnis 
Du unterstützt aktiv dabei Umsatzziele zu erreichen 
Produktexpertise & Beratung 
Du bist Expert:in für unsere Produkte – von Inhaltsstoffen über Texturen bis hin zu Shades und Anwendungstechniken 
Du demonstrierst unsere Produkte professionell und bietest Make-up Touch-ups direkt am Counter an 
Du berätst individuell, typgerecht und trendbewusst 
Du stellst höchste Hygiene- und Servicestandards sicher 
Community & Markenpräsenz 
Du repräsentierst CAIA authentisch und überzeugend auf der Fläche 
Du baust aktiv langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst einen festen Kundenstamm 
Du setzt POS-Aktivierungen, Events und Promotion-Aktionen professionell und wirkungsvoll am Counter um 
Counter Support & Warenpräsentation 
Du sorgst für eine ansprechende Präsentation unserer Produkte gemäß Visual-Merchandising-Vorgaben 
Du unterstützt bei der Pflege des Counters und achtest auf Ordnung und Sauberkeit 
Du hilfst dabei, die Warenverfügbarkeit am Counter sicherzustellen 
DEIN PROFIL 
Erste Erfahrung im stationären Einzelhandel, idealerweise im Beauty- oder Premiumsegment 
Leidenschaft für Make-up, Beauty und aktuelle Trends 
Gute Produkt- und Anwendungskenntnisse im Bereich Make-up 
Eine Ausbildung als Make-up Artist oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil 
Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt 
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind zwingend erforderlich , Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus 
VERGÜTUNG 
Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt – abhängig von Deiner Qualifikation, Berufserfahrung und Deinen individuellen Kompetenzen – in Vollzeit zwischen 28.000 € und 38.000 € brutto jährlich. Zusätzlich erhältst Du einen attraktiven jährlichen Bonus, der an die Erreichung vereinbarter Ziele geknüpft ist. Dich erwartet außerdem ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit einem starken Teamzusammenhalt sowie regelmäßigen Teamevents und gemeinsamen Aktivitäten, die den Austausch fördern und den Teamspirit nachhaltig stärken. 
Bei CAIA wirst du Teil einer der spannendsten und am schnellsten wachsenden Beauty-Brands Skandinaviens. Dich erwartet ein kreatives, dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Teamgeist, Community und Expertise eng miteinander verbunden sind. Als Beauty Consultant treibst du nicht nur den Verkauf voran — du baust Beziehungen auf, teilst dein Wissen und schaffst inspirierende Beauty-Momente, die Kund:innen zu echten CAIA Fans machen. 
Wenn du Retail und Beauty liebst, Freude am Aufbau einer Community hast und mit fachlicher Expertise überzeugen möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. 
Lass uns gemeinsam die Erfolgsgeschichte von CAIA weiterschreiben.

verdane-inriver:teamtailor:f710cc58-704d.title: Global Application Support Manager
verdane-inriver:teamtailor:f710cc58-704d.description:
Inriver runs a global SaaS platform where thousands of brands and manufacturers rely on every hour of every day to control their product information. Our Application Support team is the last line of defence when something goes wrong — and the first voice customers hear when they need expert help. We are looking for a hands-on leader who can own that mission from end to end. 
You will manage a small, geographically distributed team spanning Europe, the US, and Asia, delivering 24/7 support coverage to enterprise customers around the world. This is not a ticket-routing role. You will be the senior escalation point for complex technical problems, a coach who raises the bar for every engineer on the team, and the person who turns recurring pain into permanent fixes by partnering closely with Product and Engineering. 
What you will do 
Lead, develop, and retain a distributed support engineering team operating across multiple time zones with a 24/7 service commitment. 
Act as the primary escalation point for high-severity customer incidents, driving resolution while keeping internal and external stakeholders informed. 
Build and refine support processes — triage, escalation, root-cause analysis, knowledge management — so the team scales without scaling headcount linearly. 
Own support metrics (response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, backlog health) and use them to drive continuous improvement. 
Partner with Engineering and Product to feed field intelligence back into the platform — turning support patterns into roadmap input. 
Recruit, onboard, and mentor support engineers; create clear growth paths that keep talented people engaged. 
Manage on-call rotations and coverage plans that respect work-life balance across regions while honouring SLA commitments. 
Contribute directly to troubleshooting when depth is needed — you are comfortable digging into queries, infrastructure, and logs alongside your team. 
Required Skills & Qualifications:
We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll thrive here if you have many of the below 
Leadership and operations: 
✔️Proven experience managing a technical support or application engineering team in a SaaS or cloud software environment. 
✔️Track record of running 24/7 or follow-the-sun support models with geographically distributed staff. 
✔️Strong instinct for when to coach, when to delegate, and when to step in and drive an incident yourself. 
✔️Ability to communicate crisply with customers, executives, and engineers — adjusting depth and tone to the audience. 
✔️Agile mindset: comfortable iterating process, measuring outcomes, and changing course quickly. 
Technical depth: 
✔️Solid working knowledge of relational databases, specifically Azure SQL — you can read execution plans, reason for indexing, and guide engineers through query-level troubleshooting. 
✔️Understanding Azure infrastructure: App Services, Storage, Networking, Entra ID, monitoring (Application Insights, Log Analytics). You do not need to architect these systems, but you need to navigate them confidently during an incident. 
✔️Familiarity with SaaS operational concerns: multi-tenancy, deployment pipelines, feature flags, SLA management, and incident response. 
✔️Experience with support tooling (ticketing systems, monitoring dashboards, knowledge bases) and a point of view on how to make them work well together. 
Nice to have 
✔️Experience with PIM, MDM, or product data domains. 
✔️Background in .NET / C# environments. 
✔️Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or similar. 
✔️ITIL foundation or equivalent service-management exposure (we value the thinking, not the certificate). 
Why Inriver💙 
At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the center and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. 
Here you’ll get: 
A supportive team culture with space to learn, lead, and grow 
A workplace where your voice matters and your work makes a difference 
We’re serious about building a strong business - and we also care about enjoying the ride. 
In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like: 
Tuesday Fika ☕ 
Friday breakfasts to start the day together 
A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join 
A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way 
We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline. 
Ready to apply? 📬 
We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!

Leadership and operations:

✔️Track record of running 24/7 or follow-the-sun support models with geographically distributed staff.

✔️Strong instinct for when to coach, when to delegate, and when to step in and drive an incident yourself.

✔️Ability to communicate crisply with customers, executives, and engineers — adjusting depth and tone to the audience.

✔️Agile mindset: comfortable iterating process, measuring outcomes, and changing course quickly.

Technical depth:

✔️Solid working knowledge of relational databases, specifically Azure SQL — you can read execution plans, reason for indexing, and guide engineers through query-level troubleshooting.

✔️Understanding Azure infrastructure: App Services, Storage, Networking, Entra ID, monitoring (Application Insights, Log Analytics). You do not need to architect these systems, but you need to navigate them confidently during an incident.

✔️Familiarity with SaaS operational concerns: multi-tenancy, deployment pipelines, feature flags, SLA management, and incident response.

✔️Experience with support tooling (ticketing systems, monitoring dashboards, knowledge bases) and a point of view on how to make them work well together.

Nice to have

✔️Experience with PIM, MDM, or product data domains.

✔️Background in .NET / C# environments.

✔️Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or similar.

✔️ITIL foundation or equivalent service-management exposure (we value the thinking, not the certificate).

Why Inriver💙

At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the center and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together.

Here you’ll get:

waed-pasqal:teamtailor:a2de0073-f297-477.title: Commis achats et inventaire - Purchasing and Inventory Clerk
waed-pasqal:teamtailor:a2de0073-f297-477.description:
PASQAL designs and develops Quantum Processing Units and dedicated software tools. These innovative processors address applications which are out of the reach of the most powerful existing supercomputers, encompassing real-world challenges as well as fundamental science. As they are very low energy intensive, they will significantly contribute to reduce the carbon footprint of the computing industry. With partnerships with key users in the fields of energy, IT, finance, drug and chemical design, automotive PASQAL is a true leader in the Neutral Atom Quantum computing space.
Reporting to the Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for processing purchase orders and performing inventory checks for materials, equipment, and products. This position offers the opportunity to work in a high-technology manufacturing environment where your contribution will be key to maintaining efficient and smooth operations.
Responsabilities 
Perform inventory transactions, including parts receiving and issuing.
Conduct cycle count inventory audits.
Reconcile system-calculated inventory levels in the ERP with physical/manual stock counts.
Generate ERP reports detailing the quantity, type, and value of materials and inventory on hand.
Receive, inspect, and store goods in accordance with established procedures.
Monitor and follow up on backorders and inventory levels.
Manage Kanban processes and other day-to-day internal distribution activities in a manufacturing environment.
Collaborate with production departments to ensure availability of missing items after receipt.
Manage the full purchasing cycle for standard bill-of-materials (BOM) items within an ERP system: vendor creation, purchase order issuance, order follow-up, goods receipt, and transaction closure.
Work closely with the accounting team on invoice reconciliation and payment processing.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to purchasing processes, inventory control, and cost management.
Profile 
Minimum of 3 years of experience in inventory management or purchasing.
Strong proficiency in navigating ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.
Excellent organizational skills, communication abilities, and teamwork mindset.
Strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, analytical skills, and rigor
Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Knowledge of the NetSuite ERP system.
Bilingualism (French and English) 
__________________________________________________________________________________________________________
PASQAL conçoit et développe des processeurs quantiques (QPUs : Quantum Processing Units) et les outils logiciels associés. 
Notre technologie innovante permet de traiter des cas d’usage qui sont à ce jour hors de portée des plus puissants des supercalculateurs ; ces cas peuvent concerner des défis industriels applicatifs aussi bien que les besoins des sciences fondamentales. 
Au-delà de la puissance de calcul exceptionnelle qu’ils apportent, les QPUs sont d’une très grande efficacité énergétique et contribueront à réduire fortement l’empreinte carbone de l’industrie du calcul intensif.
Responsabilités 
Effectuer les entrées et sorties des pièces en inventaire. 
Réaliser les décomptes d'inventaire cyclique. 
Faire concorder les inventaires calculés par le système ERP avec les décomptes manuels des articles en stock. 
Produire les rapports ERP calculant la quantité, la nature et la valeur des matériaux et des stocks disponibles en inventaire. 
Effectuer et contrôler la réception et l’entreposage des marchandises selon procédures établies. 
Assurer le suivi des  back order , des inventaires. 
Gérer les processus Kanban et autres activités courantes d'une distribution interne en milieu manufacturier. 
Collaborer avec les départements de production pour assurer la disponibilité des produits manquants après réception. 
Effectuer le cycle d’achats complet d’articles de nomenclatures standards dans un système ERP : création de fournisseurs et de bons de commande, suivi des commandes, réception des marchandises, fermeture des transactions. 
Collaborer avec l’équipe de la comptabilité pour la conciliation des factures et la gestion des paiements. 
Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus d’achats et de contrôle des inventaires et des coûts. 
Profil recherché 
Avoir cumulé un minimum de 3 ans d’expérience en gestion d’inventaire ou gestion des achats. 
Aptitudes marquées pour la navigation dans un logiciels ERP et la suite Microsoft Office. 
Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et à respecter des échéanciers serrés. 
Excellente organisation du travail, capacité de communication et de travail en équipe. 
Sens des responsabilités, rigueur, esprit analytique, souci du détail. 
Compétences 
Expérience dans le secteur manufacturier ou industriel. 
Connaissance du système ERP NetSuite. 
Bilinguisme (français et anglais). 
What we offer 
· Beautiful brand-new office in Sherbrooke, Quebec, Canada
· Flexible schedules to support work/life balance
· A dynamic, close-knit, collaborative, and diverse international team for co-workers
· An impactful role in a growing scale-up that is leading in the Neutral Atom Quantum Computing space
· Competitive benefit packages
· Team outings
· Free time to learn and attend conferences/meetups
Recruitment process 
A 20-30 minute interview with our talent acquisition team via Teams Video meeting
A 1 hour video interview with hiring manager via Teams Video meeting
For technical roles: A technical Interview round via Teams Video with the hiring manager
Final Interview
An offer !
PASQAL is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, as inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, music preference, ethnicity, age, religion or sexual orientation.

yc-zip:ashbyhq:3db4137e-8828-4439-8d72-8.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Technical Account Management
yc-zip:ashbyhq:3db4137e-8828-4439-8d72-8.description:
ABOUT ZIP



Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.


YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Strategic Customer Success Manager (equivalent to a Technical Account Manager) to manage our rapidly growing customer base across all industries and customer segments from Growth to Enterprise customers.  As a CSM, you’ll be able to work directly with engineering and product while also working with a variety of stakeholders as customers. As every business can benefit from our platform, you’ll also get exposure to different types of companies and industries.  You will advise customers on how to transform the way they manage B2B purchasing across their business, creating immediate value and efficiency for employees.

You will manage a portfolio of clients across all types of clients and be responsible for driving customer success. This role is ideal for you if you enjoy building, creative problem solving, and want to work with a world class team and customers such as Coinbase, Snowflake, Toast, Northwestern Mutual, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks, Miro, and many more.




YOU WILL

 - Define customer business outcomes and partner with our customers to deliver those outcomes on a continuous basis.

 - Act as a trusted procurement advisor and thought partner to continuously educate and enable our customers on Zip’s platform and procurement best practices.

 - Identify champions and build relationships with key business stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT/Security, and Privacy/Compliance teams.

 - Maintain high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction with a focus on customer adoption and loyalty.

 - Manage customer health based on data-driven adoption metrics.

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to translate business needs and requirements into new solutions for customers, while skillfully managing customer expectations.

 - Train and empower customers to be product specialists to become increasingly self-sufficient for their organization.

 - Partner with Sales to manage renewals to achieve target NRR.

 - Continuously improve Customer Success assets and processes. We’re an early stage company, we want people who are excited to build and motivated to up-level the status quo!


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years relevant work experience working in customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organisation. B2B SaaS experience in a high-paced environment is a benefit.

 - Procurement experience (procurement, sourcing, or vendor management background) and / or  familiarity with procurement technologies such as ERP (Netsuite, Coupa, etc.), HRIS (Workday etc.), CLM, GRC, JIRA, ServiceNow workflow management tools

 - Excellent interpersonal skills and ability establish quick rapport and trust with customers

 - Strong project management skills to manage a dynamic customer portfolio.

 - Creative problem solver while being attentive to details

 - Business process-oriented and ability to think about workflow efficiency (e.g. diagrams, conditionally based logic, etc.)

 - Proactive team player that is able to identify process gaps and willing to jump in and help wherever needed (company, team, self mentality)


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with SaaS workflow management tools (low code / no code configuration)

 - Procurement, legal, financial, or IT systems background (fluency or exposure)

 - Experience working in a top tier consulting firm or have an MBA


PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget
   
   

We're looking to hire Zippers and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

We’re looking for a Strategic Customer Success Manager (equivalent to a Technical Account Manager) to manage our rapidly growing customer base across all industries and customer segments from Growth to Enterprise customers.  As a CSM, you’ll be able to work directly with engineering and product while also working with a variety of stakeholders as customers. As every business can benefit from our platform, you’ll also get exposure to different types of companies and industries.  You will advise customers on how to transform the way they manage B2B purchasing across their business, creating immediate value and efficiency for employees.

You will manage a portfolio of clients across all types of clients and be responsible for driving customer success. This role is ideal for you if you enjoy building, creative problem solving, and want to work with a world class team and customers such as Coinbase, Snowflake, Toast, Northwestern Mutual, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks, Miro, and many more.

You Will

  • Define customer business outcomes and partner with our customers to deliver those outcomes on a continuous basis.

  • Act as a trusted procurement advisor and thought partner to continuously educate and enable our customers on Zip’s platform and procurement best practices.

  • Identify champions and build relationships with key business stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT/Security, and Privacy/Compliance teams.

  • Maintain high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction with a focus on customer adoption and loyalty.

  • Manage customer health based on data-driven adoption metrics.

  • Partner closely with product and engineering to translate business needs and requirements into new solutions for customers, while skillfully managing customer expectations.

  • Train and empower customers to be product specialists to become increasingly self-sufficient for their organization.

  • Partner with Sales to manage renewals to achieve target NRR.

  • Continuously improve Customer Success assets and processes. We’re an early stage company, we want people who are excited to build and motivated to up-level the status quo!

Qualifications

  • 10+ years relevant work experience working in customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organisation. B2B SaaS experience in a high-paced environment is a benefit.

  • Procurement experience (procurement, sourcing, or vendor management background) and / or  familiarity with procurement technologies such as ERP (Netsuite, Coupa, etc.), HRIS (Workday etc.), CLM, GRC, JIRA, ServiceNow workflow management tools

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability establish quick rapport and trust with customers

  • Strong project management skills to manage a dynamic customer portfolio.

  • Creative problem solver while being attentive to details

  • Business process-oriented and ability to think about workflow efficiency (e.g. diagrams, conditionally based logic, etc.)

  • Proactive team player that is able to identify process gaps and willing to jump in and help wherever needed (company, team, self mentality)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with SaaS workflow management tools (low code / no code configuration)

  • Procurement, legal, financial, or IT systems background (fluency or exposure)

  • Experience working in a top tier consulting firm or have an MBA

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

We're looking to hire Zippers and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

zeldavc-my-kargo:greenhouse:4163960004.title: Supply Chain Lead
zeldavc-my-kargo:greenhouse:4163960004.description:
At Kargo, our mission is to build a connective tissue between the physical world of freight and the digital ecosystem used to manage it. We believe that advancements in smart infrastructure are critical to enabling a safer and more efficient future for logistics.  Our loading dock sensor platform verifies all incoming and outgoing freight, aggregating data that enables shippers and carriers to efficiently manage dock operations, switch out suppliers and understand material flow in real time. 

We care deeply about delivering the best solutions for our customers. As a member of the Kargo team, you will have the opportunity to develop and deploy tomorrow’s hardware & software solutions and help revolutionize logistics.

Responsibilities

  • Demand Planning - Develop accurate demand forecasts partnering with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Operations and Leadership. 
  • Strategic Sourcing - Manage strategic sourcing initiatives such as supplier evaluation and partner management. Responsible for the full product lifecycle from selection to delivery, and managing quality assurance initiatives. 
  • Procurement / Inventory Management - Responsible for cost reduction, contract negotiations, purchase orders, and maintaining satisfactory inventory levels.
  • Logistics - Coordinate all logistics related activities including management of air, ocean, and customs brokerage. 
  • Travel - Once a month to visit suppliers in China and Taiwan.

Experience

  • 5+ years experience supply chain.
  • Technical background in engineering or manufacturing preferred.
  • Proven track record managing redundant supply chains and cost avoidance without sacrificing quality.
  • Manufacturing or Industrial Logistics domain expertise preferred.
  • Experience in enterprise-level material planning (ERP) and associated tools preferred.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Mandarin speaking proficiency, spoken and written.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.

Kargo is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
